 WTA Tokyo Quarterfinal Best Bets Including Elena Rybakina vs Leylah Fernandez 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 The WTA Tokyo tournament, also known as the Pan Pacific Open, begins in Japan. This is a WTA 500 event, but it has no bearing on the upcoming WTA Finals and the race to Indian Wells. That competition is over, with the WTA formally announcing in early November that all eight singles players have qualified. The Pan Pacific Open is therefore a straightforward tournament where players try to build their rankings for the start of the 2027 season and earn prize money. A 500-point tournament offers the chance to make a major gain in the rankings. It’s a lot more than a WTA 250. Let’s see which players still have the energy and form to make a run at this late-season tournament and build confidence heading into the offseason. Fall tennis differs from spring or summer tennis because some players are more tired at this point in the year, opening the door for others to make their mark at this 2026 WTA Tokyo event. LWOS has our best bets for three matches. Post your best bets and thoughts in the comments. 
 WTA Tokyo 
 Rakhimova – Joint: 20:30 EST 
 H2H: 0-0 
 In this WTA Tokyo match, Maya Joint will try to continue her strong run of recent form against Kamilla Rakhimova. Joint lost more matches than she won in the first half of the 2026 tennis season, but in the second half, it has been a different story. After her recent Tokyo win over Cristina Bucsa, Joint has won four matches in a row and six of seven. Rakhimova, however, just upset Ekaterina Alexandrova, so she is feeling confident going into this match. 
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Tokyo match isn’t easy to predict, but Joint is earning trust with six wins in seven matches. It’s hard to bet against her when she looks so dialed in. Take Joint to win. 
 That being said, betting on Joint winning is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Joint winning at @1.83 @unibet 
 Pohankova – Parks: 22:00 EST 
 H2H: 0-0 
 In this WTA Tokyo match, we have a pair of players no one expected to be here in the quarterfinals. Mia Pohankova stunned Naomi Osaka in the Round of 16, a result that came out of nowhere. Pohankova is playing her best tennis of the year right now. She won’t want the 2026 season to end. Alycia Parks, like Pohankova, is ranked outside the top 60 on the WTA Tour. Her run to the quarterfinals was no sure thing, but she hasn’t beaten opponents as good as Osaka. Pohankova has been installed as the clear betting market favorite.  
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Tokyo match has to be a situation in which you bet on Pohankova. Beating Osaka anywhere is impressive. Beating Osaka in Japan is extra special. Pohankova deserves the lean here for any tennis bettor. Take the game spread. 
 That being said, betting on Pohankova -2.5 games is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Pohankova -2.5 games @1.75 @betfair 
 Rybakina – Fernandez: 00:30 EST 
 H2H: 4-2 
 This WTA Tokyo match is an interesting one. Elena Rybakina has beaten Leylah Fernandez twice in 2026, but one match had a third-set tiebreak back in the spring in Stuttgart. The other match was played not very long ago in Ningbo, with Rybakina winning 6-2, 6-2. Will this match be close the way Stuttgart was, or will it be a blowout the way Ningbo was? 
 Aug 9, 2023; Montreal, Quebec, Canada; Leylah Fernandez (CAN) hits a forehand against Beatrice Haddad Maia (BRA) during second round play at IGA Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Eric Bolte-USA TODAY Sports | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Jim Smith 
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Tokyo match can be bet on in two ways. You could bet on Rybakina to win in straight sets, given the Ningbo result, or you can bet on Fernandez to make the match closer, believing that this won’t be like Ningbo and that Fernandez will have a better day on the court. Either bet is a good one, but we’re going to lean to the Fernandez standalone wager. 
 That being said, betting on Fernandez +4.5 games is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Fernandez +4.5 games @1.78 @1xbet 
 Eala – Shnaider: 3:00 EST 
 H2H: 0-1 
 This WTA Tokyo match is a rematch of a Ningbo match played very recently. Diana Shnaider won a close match over Alexandra Eala, 7-5 6-4, covering a 3.5-game spread. Will Shnaider be able to replicate that, or can Eala turn the tables? 
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Tokyo match betting angle is very simple: Will this match be closer than Ningbo, or not? We think Eala, playing on her home continent (Asia), will be a little more motivated than Shnaider and can move the margins in her favor. 
 That being said, betting on Eala +3.5 games is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Eala +3.5 games @1.70 @betfair
